d: It’s the magical time of year where Trump won’t win the Nobel Peace Prize, he keeps on musing that Iran could bomb LA and San Diego, someone finally told him that he's mispronouncing the word vegan, Trump keeps making promises he hasn’t kept, Kimberly Guilfoyle was trying to get a big Trump donor to pay her American Express bill, the Dodgers are headed to Milwaukee to play the Brewers in the playoffs, and This Week in Unnecessary Censorship.
